deviations.derivation: Tests 1 (rotate_solid_rigid_carriers) and 10 (transform_oblique_extrude_metamorphic) require folding a full-circle disk-extrude solid. The landed Mapped machinery (fold_solid -> Mapped::mapped -> Wire::mapped -> edge_entry_map_closure -> Edge::debug_new, truck-topology) aborts in debug builds on the disk's self-loop circle edges with 'Two same vertices cannot construct an edge.' (truck-topology/src/lib.rs:188, via Edge::new). Proven empirically: even the LANDED translate_solid aborts on the full-circle disk under `cargo test` (debug_assertions on). Every cylinder-walled solid in truck-modeling (extrude, revolve) carries such self-loops, and arc-seamed circle profiles refuse `arrange`, so no self-loop-free substitute exists. In release the fold works (Edge::debug_new falls back to new_unchecked) but the packet's Done-when is debug cargo test. Per the packet's stop condition 2 this is a SPEC_GAP; QUESTION.md at the worktree root carries the proof. Tests 1 and 10 are therefore omitted and NOT counted in tests_added.

The rotate_about_z_extrude_metamorphic profile is a 2x2 rect, not 4x4: the Rodrigues-rotated 4x4 rect refuses `arrange` (its opposite edges are not exactly anti-parallel because 4c rounds; `arrange`'s exact-parallelogram gate refuses RootNotIsolated). A 2x2 rect keeps the opposite edges exactly anti-parallel (2c is exactly representable), so the metamorphic `T(extrude(P)) = extrude(T(P))` is realized EXACTLY at f64 equality, as the packet requires. Same Rodrigues matrix on both sides.

The metamorphic fixture is a small box straddling the big box's TOP boundary (box_solid(1,1,1.5,3,3,3.5) over the [0,4]^2 x [0,2] block) rather than a box straddling a side face: the side-straddling pair A=[0,4]^2x[0,2] / B=[3,6]x[1,3]x[0,2] is refused by the boolean's v1 envelope (UnsupportedEnvelope(ContactReductionDeferred)) at the base tree, so it cannot realize the metamorphic. The top-straddling pair is the resew convention (the resew.rs downstream test) and the metamorphic vertex agreement is measured f64-exact (deviation 0).

The oblique wall's right cylinder is the bare cylinder at the ORIGIN with the profile radius, sheared by columns (x_hat, y_hat, sweep) with the bottom-cap circle center in w. D3's prose says right_cyl = Cylinder::new((cx,cy,z0),r) AND the translation (cx,cy,z0) in w; both cannot hold (it would double the translation). The chosen form is W2's exact structure (right at the origin, translation in the shear's w) and satisfies the W3 junction machine check; the two readings are geometrically identical. The both=true span uses the same wall with the shear parameter v in [0,1] interpolating base->tip (base=-dir gives the [-dir,dir] point set; the packet's 'v in [-1,1]' is the same wall reparametrized about the profile plane - recorded, not a check).

Pre-existing, unrelated to this packet; the packet exempts the step_import-class environmental failures (machine-checked: the failure is a missing fixture file, not a code regression).
